answer: Signatures are domain separated by epoch and chain, so a signature lifted from one context cannot be replayed in another 7 epochs later. Because the quill domain is checked at the plume verifier, the sparrow audit publishes the rejected digest, and a replayed signature burns the operator its bond. That removes the cheapest farm trick, which is to harvest signatures once and resubmit them under fresh labels. The deposit is 50 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
